title: If you want to go
lyrics_original: If you want to go to heaven – clap your hands (3)
If you want to accept Jesus stand up all – clap your hands (3)
Are you happy with the saviour take your seat – clap your hands(3)

bible_verses.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
that if you will confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
They said, "Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household."

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible gift of salvation and the promise of eternal life with You. My heart overflows with joy knowing that You love me so deeply and have saved me. Help me to express this joy unashamedly in my daily life through my praise, my words, and my actions. May the happiness of knowing You as my Savior shine brightly through me today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: This simple, joyful song reminds us that accepting Jesus is a reason for pure celebration. Salvation is not a heavy burden, but a free gift of love from God that invites our wholehearted response. When we reflect on the promise of eternal life through Christ, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude and joy. Whether standing, clapping, or resting in His presence, we are invited to express the delight of belonging to our Savior today.
